name: Obsidian Aurum: Private Bank Editorial (final)
thesis: The people who decide whether Preetham gets the room (founders, research leads, hiring committees at AI labs) do not respond to neon, typewriters or floating badges; they respond to the visual grammar of institutions that hold other people's money: a warm near-black ground, one desaturated gold used like foil stamping, an engraved high-contrast serif set with generous margins, hairline rules that organise real information, and numerals aligned like a ledger so that 0.07% and 1,800+ read as audited facts rather than marketing. Every number on this page is real, so the design's job is to make the record feel verified, not decorated. Motion is slow and heavy: headlines rise out of clip masks the way a plate is lifted off paper, rules draw themselves under the words they belong to, figures roll into place once, and the single gold nebula appears only twice, at the introduction and at the letter of contact, responding to the visitor's own scroll speed in those two places so it reads as a signature rather than wallpaper. Nothing on the page comes from the current premium AI kit: no pill buttons with nested arrow circles, no floating island nav, no bento, no tilt card, no marquee, no count-ups, no watermark. The result positions Preetham as someone already operating at the level of the institutions he wants to be hired by, with the content doing the claiming and the design refusing to shout.

typography.display: Bodoni Moda via next/font/google (Bodoni_Moda, axes: ["opsz"], subsets: ["latin"], style: ["normal", "italic"], weight: ["400", "500"], display: swap). CSS variable --font-display registered in @theme inline. Used only at 22px and above.
typography.display_rationale: Of the three permitted serifs, Bodoni Moda is the only one whose DNA is engraving: banknotes, share certificates and fashion mastheads are Bodoni, so the thick-thin contrast instantly reads as printed money and private-bank stationery, which is the whole angle. Cormorant Garamond at display size drifts toward wedding stationery (swashy italics, spindly 300 weight) and has become the most common AI serif pick in this pool; EB Garamond is a text face that goes limp above 40px. Bodoni Moda is also the only one shipped with an optical-size axis, so opsz resolves to 96 for headlines (maximum hairline contrast, the engraved look) and thickens strokes automatically at 22px to 28px where hairlines would otherwise break. It is never used below 22px; everything small is Geist or Geist Mono. Light-on-dark rendering slightly blooms thin strokes, which helps Bodoni rather than hurting it. Italic emphasis stays in the same family (Bodoni Moda italic 400) and is used for exactly one word on the whole page, 'acts' in the hero.
display_weights: 500 (h3-size titles: experience roles, project titles, skills group heads, testimonial company names)
400 italic (the single word 'acts' in the hero headline, and the pull quote in Testimonials)
typography.body: Geist via next/font/google (weights 400, 500). 16px/1.65 desktop, 15px/1.6 mobile, tracking 0. Long-form About prose 18px/1.7 on a 62ch measure. Never 600 or heavier.
typography.mono: Geist Mono via next/font/google (weight 400). Every ledger numeral caption, period, tag, count and the three eyebrows. font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums wherever a digit appears.
typography.scale: h1: desktop clamp(3.5rem, 6.2vw, 5.25rem) Bodoni 400, tracking -0.01em, leading 1.04, two lines ('AI that acts,' / 'not just answers.'), each line inside its own clip mask with pb-2 reserve so the j descender in 'just' is never clipped; mobile 2.5rem, leading 1.06. h2: desktop 3rem (48px) Bodoni 400, tracking -0.005em, leading 1.1; mobile 2.125rem (34px). h3: desktop 1.75rem (28px) Bodoni 500, leading 1.2; mobile 1.375rem (22px). Display numerals (Achievements, About hanging figures, GitHub figure row): 3rem to 7.5rem Bodoni 400 tabular lining nums, leading 0.95; mobile 2.5rem to 3.5rem. Body: Geist 1rem/1.65 desktop, 0.9375rem/1.6 mobile, max-w 65ch. Ledger rows and metadata: Geist Mono 0.875rem tabular, tracking 0.01em. Tags and captions: Geist Mono 0.75rem, tracking 0.04em, sentence case, never uppercase. The three eyebrows only: Geist Mono 0.6875rem (11px), uppercase, tracking 0.18em, ivory-200. Nav links: Geist 0.8125rem (13px), tracking 0. Italic descender rule: any italic word containing y g j p q gets leading 1.1 minimum and pb-1 reserve (the only italic display word, 'acts', has none).

palette.use: Page ground, html background, loader panel, mobile menu overlay, CosmicScene colorC for every chapter. Never #000.
Raised surface: scrolled navbar fill at 92% alpha, open accordion panel tint at 60% alpha, input fill on focus
Highest surface: toast body, heatmap level-0 cell, skeleton rows, mobile sticky backdrop
Primary text: headlines, display numerals, active nav link, the heatmap today-cell ring (17:1 on obsidian-0)
Secondary text: body paragraphs, subtext, quote attribution roles, inactive nav links, eyebrows (8.9:1)
Tertiary metadata only, minimum 12px: periods, tags, footer copyright, placeholder text, inactive index names (4.86:1, AA at 12px+; never body text)
Nebula highlight core in the shader, keyboard focus ring (2px, offset 3px), heatmap level-4
Hover state of every gold element (text links, CTA border, drawn rules), heatmap level-3, form error text (11:1) paired with a Warning icon and aria-invalid

THE accent, used identically everywhere: active nav hairline, CTA text and border, link underline, drawn headline rules, the single live-availability indicator, nebula colorA, heatmap level-2, testimonial dwell line, selection background at 30% alpha. Saturation 49%, 8.8:1 on obsidian-0.
Pressed state of gold interactive elements, heatmap level-1, second segment of the language distribution bar
Nebula colorB (the deep umber body of the cloud; must stay this dark or the gold turns orange), lowest visible tint in the shader
Every structural rule: row separators, nav bottom border when scrolled, portrait plate frames, input underlines at rest, achievements dividers
Hover state of rows, open accordion header, column rules in the skills index
The rule that draws under every h2 and the h1 on reveal, input underline on focus, the active testimonial name marker, the secondary CTA underline

radius_system: All-sharp. --radius: 0 declared once in @theme inline in globals.css; border-radius 0 on every container, plate, image, input, textarea, button, toast, accordion panel, heatmap cell, tab, skeleton and the mobile menu overlay. The double bezel of the portrait plate is expressed with two square hairline frames (outer at inset 0, inner at inset 12px), never with rounding. The single exception is the 6px live-availability indicator in the Contact eyebrow, which is rounded-full because it is a dot and not a container. Focus rings are square (outline, not box-shadow, so they inherit 0 radius). No component may declare its own radius; a grep for 'rounded-' in src/components must return only the one 'rounded-full' on the indicator.

hero.layout: Editorial split on a 12-column grid inside max-w-[1280px] px-6 lg:px-10, pt-20 lg:pt-24 (the cap), min-h-[100dvh], content vertically centred in the height remaining under the nav. Columns 1-7: the text block, left-aligned, its top aligned to the portrait plate's top edge. Columns 8-12: the portrait plate, a 4:5 frame (about 480x600 at 1280) with a hairline outer frame and a second hairline inset 12px. No rule above the eyebrow and no full-width hairline anywhere in the hero; the only rule is the 1px hairline-gold line that draws directly beneath the headline's second baseline, the same ritual every h2 gets. Tablet (768 to 1023): 6/6 split, plate capped at 420px. Mobile (<768): single column; the plate becomes a 3:4 frame at 56vw width, right-aligned above the text, capped at 38vh on a 390x844 device and at 30vh when the viewport is 700px tall or less (390x667 check), so eyebrow, both headline lines, subtext and both CTAs sit inside the first viewport on both devices.
hero.headline: AI that *acts*, not just answers.
hero.subtext: Autonomous agents, multimodal RAG and self-healing data security, built at Matters.AI, Introspect Labs and IIT (ISM) Dhanbad.
hero.portrait_treatment: The existing /ai-headshot.webp (504x690, loading eager, fetchPriority high, width and height attributes, jpeg fallback via the existing picture element) fills the 4:5 plate with object-cover at radius 0. Two stacked layers of the same image inside the plate: the lower layer carries the photogravure grade as a static CSS filter (grayscale(1) sepia(0.28) contrast(1.06) brightness(0.92)), the upper layer is the untouched colour image at opacity 0. On hover or focus-within the colour layer transitions opacity 0 to 1 over 900ms cubic-bezier(0.7,0,0.2,1) and drains back on leave; opacity is compositor-only, so no filter is ever animated on the LCP image. A bottom scrim linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 55%, rgba(12,10,8,0.55)) sits above both layers so the gold nebula behind the plate never fights the face. No corner brackets, no badge, no flip, no ID card, no rings, no pills on the image, no caption. AvatarFlipCard.tsx is deleted and replaced by PortraitPlate.tsx: a figure with tabIndex 0 and an aria-label ('Portrait of Preetham Nimmagadda'), the two image layers, and two absolutely positioned hairline frames. Primary CTA: Geist 500 15px ivory-100 on a 1px aurum-300 border, px-7 py-3.5, radius 0, trailing ArrowDownRight (Phosphor light, 16px) that translates 2px down-right on hover; hover fills the button with aurum-300 and flips the label to obsidian-0 (13:1); pressed state aurum-400. Secondary CTA: text link in ivory-200 with a 1px hairline-gold underline that thickens to 2px aurum-200 on hover. Both labels fit on one line at 320px. MagneticButton.tsx is retired.
hero.webgl_role: CosmicScene remains the single fixed canvas; the change is a chapter-table recolour plus three uniforms. Every SCENE_CHAPTERS entry is recoloured to colorA #C9A961, colorB #7A6134, colorC #0C0A08 (colorB must stay this umber; the shaders were tuned for violet and a brighter B turns the cloud orange). Each chapter gains intensity and constellationOpacity fields lerped by getSceneState with the existing blend: hero 1.0 / 0, about 0 / 0, experience 0 / 0, skills 0 / 0.12, projects 0 / 0, activity 0 / 0, achievements 0 / 0, testimonials 0 / 0, contact 1.0 / 0. The hero chapter's camera moves to [0.9, 0.3, 6.5] so the brightest lobe sits upper-right behind and slightly above the portrait plate, gold light appearing to leak from behind the plate; the contact chapter's camera moves to [0, -0.6, 7] so the cloud sits low behind the letter column. The nebula fragment multiplies its alpha by uIntensity; the existing additive-blend opacities are halved when going gold; GPUStars are retinted to ivory-200 and reduced about 40% so they read as warm dust; shooting stars are disabled. Velocity heat (grafted): the existing vNorm to uVelocity path in AuroraNebula's useFrame also lerps colorB toward colorA by vNorm * 0.6 and lifts colorA luminance by vNorm * 0.25, gated by uIntensity so the response exists only in the hero and contact chapters. The scene still mounts after useIdle fires; until then a static radial-gradient(60% 45% at 78% 30%, rgba(201,169,97,0.10), transparent 70%) on the hero section stands in. No new listeners: the viewport-store already feeds progress and velocity. Reduced motion: no canvas is mounted; the hero keeps the static radial gradient and the contact section gets a mirrored one at 50% 85%.
hero.entrance_choreography: Clock starts on the existing loader-done event (useLoaderDone preserved), which fires at the start of the loader's exit wipe so the last 400ms overlap. t=0: the loader's aurum-300 progress line, already stretched to full viewport width, contracts (scaleX, origin left) to the width of the headline's second line and settles at the h1 baseline as the hero's hairline-gold rule over 700ms cubic-bezier(0.7,0,0.2,1); this is the match cut, one element handing the eye from loader to headline. t=150ms: eyebrow fades in with an 8px rise, 500ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1). t=300ms: headline line one rises out of its clip mask (translateY 110% to 0), 1100ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); line two follows at t=420ms with identical timing so it lands on the rule. t=200ms in parallel: the portrait plate reveals with clip-path inset(0 0 100% 0) to inset(0), 1400ms cubic-bezier(0.7,0,0.2,1), its two hairline frames drawing as strokes over the same span; the photogravure layer is already in place so nothing flashes colour. t=800ms: subtext fades up 8px, 700ms. t=1000ms: primary CTA border draws (scaleX) then its label fades, 600ms; secondary link fades at t=1100ms. Nebula uIntensity eases 0 to 1 over 2000ms from whichever is later, t=600ms or useIdle firing. Everything settles by 2.4s. Transforms and opacity only. Reduced motion: all elements opacity 0 to 1 over 200ms simultaneously, portrait in place, rule rendered at full width, no match cut.

sections.headline: AI that *acts*, not just answers.
sections.subtext: Autonomous agents, multimodal RAG and self-healing data security, built at Matters.AI, Introspect Labs and IIT (ISM) Dhanbad.
sections.layout_family: Editorial split (text 7 columns, portrait plate 5 columns)
sections.composition: See the hero block. Desktop: eyebrow, two-line headline with the drawn rule beneath, subtext, CTA pair in columns 1-7; the double-framed photogravure portrait in columns 8-12 with gold nebula light leaking from behind it. Mobile: single column, 3:4 plate at 56vw right-aligned above the text, height-capped so both CTAs stay inside the first viewport at 390x844 and 390x667.
sections.key_interaction: Portrait colour layer fades in on hover or focus-within; the primary CTA fills with aurum-300 on hover and smooth-scrolls to #projects via smoothScrollTo; the secondary link smooth-scrolls to #contact.
sections.motion: Entrance choreography above (hierarchy: rule, then identity, then thesis, then evidence, then action). On scroll the text block and plate part slightly, text y 0 to 60px and plate y 0 to -40px with text opacity falling to 0 by 50% progress, driven by one Framer useScroll on the section whose progress MotionValue writes a single CSS custom property (--hero-p) via .on('change') and style.setProperty, consumed by two CSS calc transforms (storytelling: the plate is lifted off the page; zero React renders per frame). Reduced motion: no parallax, static.

sections.headline: Engineering intelligence from first principles.
sections.layout_family: Manifesto column with hanging figures (running prose in the centre columns, one Bodoni figure hung in the left gutter per paragraph, nothing sticky, no cards)
sections.composition: py-32 lg:py-40. h2 spans columns 1-9 with the hairline-gold rule drawing beneath it. Below, four paragraphs of Geist 18px/1.7 on a 62ch measure in columns 4-11, each opening with a Bodoni Moda 500 22px lead phrase set inline in ivory-100. Hung in columns 1-3, aligned to each paragraph's first baseline and right-aligned toward the prose, one figure per paragraph in Bodoni 400 3rem tabular ivory-100 with a Geist Mono 12px ivory-300 caption beneath. Paragraph one, lead 'Systems that act.' Figure 95%, caption 'VideoRAG accuracy'. Text: I build intelligent pipelines that act instead of only answering: a self-healing data-security copilot at Matters.AI and an empathic VideoRAG companion at Introspect Labs that processes 100+ hours of video with 95% accuracy and lifted retention by 40%. Paragraph two, lead 'Rigour first.' Figure 0.07%, caption 'HackerRank, top percentile'. Text: Top 0.8% on CodeChef, top 0.07% on HackerRank and a Codeforces Specialist, I bring algorithmic discipline to production code. Paragraph three, lead 'Systems that coordinate.' Figure 20%, caption 'system load reduced, METAVERTEX'. Text: Multi-agent architectures for trading, event logistics and agentic tooling, where independent components work as one; at METAVERTEX autonomous agents cut system resource load by 20%. Paragraph four, lead 'People, at scale.' Figure 1,800+, caption 'residents as Hostel Prefect'. Text: Elected Student Senator for 1,500+ peers, Hostel Prefect for 1,800+ residents, Campus Ambassador for Perplexity. Mobile: each figure moves above its paragraph as a two-line block (figure at 2.5rem, caption beneath), prose full width at 16px. The three stat cards, the pillar cards, AnimatedCounter and SectionKicker are deleted.
sections.key_interaction: Hovering a lead phrase raises its paragraph's hanging figure from ivory-100 to aurum-300 over 400ms (the claim points at its evidence); on touch, none.
sections.motion: Paragraphs reveal one after another with a 12px rise and opacity over 900ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) via whileInView once at amount 0.4 (hierarchy: reading order). Each hanging figure uses the ledger roll-in as its paragraph enters (feedback: the figure arrives as a recorded value). Reduced motion: opacity only, 200ms, figures render final.

sections.headline: Six roles since 2024.
sections.layout_family: Sticky-left year dossier, scrolling-right grouped entries (scrollytelling column pair)
sections.composition: py-32 lg:py-40. h2 across columns 1-9 with drawn rule. Then a 12-column pair. Columns 1-4, position sticky top 128px, height 60vh: the active entry's start year as a Bodoni 400 5rem display numeral (2026, 2025, 2024), the full period beneath in Geist Mono 13px ivory-300 written with 'to' ('Mar 2026 to present', 'Jan 2026 to Mar 2026', 'June 2025 to July 2025', 'Sept 2025 to Nov 2025', 'Sept 2024 to Sept 2025', 'March 2024 to March 2025'), the company in Bodoni 500 28px ivory-100, and the role in Geist 15px ivory-200. Nothing behind the numeral (the ghost square is gone). Columns 6-12: two groups with a Geist 500 13px sentence-case group label in ivory-200 and one hairline above the label only. Group 'Industry': Matters.AI, Introspect Labs, METAVERTEX. Group 'Campus': Perplexity, Hostel Executive Committee, Students' Gymkhana, IIT (ISM). Groups are separated by 96px, entries within a group by 72px. Each entry, no card: role in Bodoni 500 28px ivory-100; company and period in Geist Mono 13px ivory-300 on one line separated by a single middle dot; the highlight in Geist Mono 12px aurum-300 in sentence case ('Autonomous AI copilot', 'Architected an AI companion', '20% efficiency gain', '20+ strategic leads', 'Led 1,800+ residents', 'Elected representative'); description in Geist 16px/1.65 ivory-200 max-w 58ch with dashes replaced; skills as plain Geist Mono 12px words with 24px gaps under a hairline top rule (no pills). The Phosphor light type icon (Briefcase, Users, Buildings, Gavel) sits at 18px ivory-300 before the role. Mobile: sticky column hidden; group labels remain; each entry gets its period as a Geist Mono line above the role; 64px gaps. The gradient rail and ping nodes are removed. The cv-auto class is removed from this section's ScrollReveal wrapper because it contains a sticky descendant.
sections.key_interaction: Each entry is observed with useInView at amount 0.5 and sets the active index; the sticky column's year, company and role swap to match. Hovering an entry raises its skills rule to hairline-strong.
sections.motion: Sticky year swaps through AnimatePresence mode popLayout inside an overflow-hidden mask: the outgoing year slides up (translateY -100%, 500ms) while the incoming one rises (translateY 100% to 0, 700ms), both cubic-bezier(0.7,0,0.2,1); company and role crossfade 400ms (state: which chapter the reader is in). Entries reveal once with a 16px rise and opacity, 900ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), amount 0.3 (hierarchy). Reduced motion: instant swap, opacity-only reveals.

sections.headline: The working toolset.
sections.subtext: Select a category to filter. The star chart behind the page follows.
sections.layout_family: Filter rail plus multi-column typographic index (annual-report index page)
sections.composition: py-28 lg:py-36 (tighter than siblings, as today). h2 and subtext stacked in columns 1-8 with the drawn rule. Filter rail: one horizontal row of eight text toggles in Geist Mono 13px, label then count in ivory-300 (AI 19, Web 14, DB 6, Cloud 9, DevOps 4, Lang 5, Tools 12, Automation 1; counts computed from skills-data at build time, never hardcoded), separated by 32px, each with a 1px underline that is hairline at rest and hairline-gold when active; the exclusive toggle logic of toggleSkillCategory is unchanged. Under the rail one Geist Mono 12px line: '70 tools across 8 categories' (also computed). Below, the 70 skills as a typographic index in CSS columns (4 at lg, 3 at md, 2 at sm) with a 1px hairline-strong column rule; each category is a group headed by its full categoryLabels string in Bodoni 500 20px ivory-100 followed by skill names in Geist 15px ivory-200 with 6px line gaps, alphabetical within the group, groups ordered by count descending. No chips, no dots, no card container, no stats bar. Mobile: the rail becomes a horizontal scroll-snapping row; the index collapses to 2 columns then 1.
sections.key_interaction: Toggling a category dims every other group to 35% opacity and raises the selected group's names to ivory-100, while the CosmicScene constellation brightens the matching category's points from 12% to 60% gold through the existing useActiveSkillCategories subscription. Toggling the active category again restores everything.
sections.motion: Group dim and restore is a 450ms opacity transition cubic-bezier(0.7,0,0.2,1) (state: what is selected); the active underline is a shared layoutId hairline that slides between toggles over 500ms (state). Index groups reveal once on entry with a 10px rise, 800ms, staggered 60ms per column (hierarchy). Layout never reflows: no AnimatePresence, no popLayout, no chip bounces. Reduced motion: opacity only, underline jumps.

sections.headline: Selected work.
sections.subtext: Six builds, three of them live.
sections.layout_family: Accordion dossier (single-open, first open by default) with a screenshot plate for the live products
sections.composition: py-32 lg:py-40. h2 and subtext in columns 1-8 with drawn rule. Then six rows spanning columns 1-12, each with a hairline top rule and the last with a bottom rule too. Closed row (88px tall): title in Bodoni 500 28px ivory-100 (columns 1-6); status as plain Geist Mono 12px text, 'Live' in aurum-300 and 'Complete' in ivory-300, no dot, no pill (columns 7-8); primary stack word in Geist Mono 12px ivory-300 (columns 9-11); a Phosphor Plus (light, 20px) in column 12 that rotates 45 degrees when open. Open row: beneath the header, a 12-column panel tinted obsidian-1 at 60%: columns 1-6 hold the description in Geist 17px/1.6 ivory-200 max-w 52ch, the full tag list as a Geist Mono 12px line with 20px gaps, and two text links 'Open live site' and 'View source' in aurum-300 with ArrowUpRight and GithubLogo (Phosphor light, 14px); for the three Complete projects only 'View source' appears. Columns 7-12 hold a real screenshot of the live product (captured at 1600x1000 from collegecentral.live, festflow.co.in and the CareerOps host, committed to /public/projects/*.webp) inside a hairline square frame at radius 0, no overlays. For the three Complete projects the image column is omitted and the description widens to columns 1-9; GitHub social-preview cards are not used and div mock-ups are forbidden. College Central is open on arrival. Descriptions rewritten without dashes, facts intact: 'One platform for academic records, campus navigation and event coordination at IIT (ISM) Dhanbad, used daily by the student body.'; 'A fully automated command center for the job search: discovering the right roles, scoring fit with AI, and managing the whole application pipeline end to end.'; 'Multi-agent AI that turns event requirements into complete logistical plans. Scheduling, budgets and vendor coordination, generated automatically.'; 'A swarm of AI agents that reads market signals and executes trading strategies autonomously, in real time.'; 'A custom VS Code build with agentic AI at its core. Natural language becomes working code, and routine project work runs itself.'; 'A Slack assistant that turns plain English into PostgreSQL insights, with auto-generated charts, one-click CSV exports and smart query caching built in.' Mobile: header collapses to title and status on one line with the Plus at right; the open panel stacks description then image.
sections.key_interaction: Click or Enter on a header opens it and closes the previous one (button with aria-expanded and aria-controls, panel with role region); hovering a closed header raises its rule to hairline-strong and slides the title 6px right.
sections.motion: The panel wrapper is display grid with grid-template-rows transitioning 0fr to 1fr over 650ms cubic-bezier(0.7,0,0.2,1) (inner div min-height 0, overflow hidden), so no height is measured and no layout thrash occurs; panel text fades in over 350ms after a 200ms delay and the screenshot reveals via clip-path inset(0 100% 0 0) to inset(0) over 900ms (state: the dossier opens; storytelling: the product is unveiled). The Plus rotates 45 degrees in 400ms. Rows reveal once with a 12px rise, 800ms, 70ms stagger (hierarchy). Reduced motion: grid transition 0ms, content opacity 200ms, Plus swaps to X without rotation.

sections.headline: Twelve months of commits, live.
sections.subtext: A year of commits and contribution streaks, pulled live from GitHub.
sections.layout_family: Data plate (bank-statement ledger: figure row, heatmap, thin distribution bar)
sections.composition: py-32 lg:py-40. Eyebrow LIVE FROM GITHUB AND CODOLIO above the h2 in columns 1-8; the h2 and subtext swap with the tab as today (Competitive tab: h2 'Ratings from five platforms, live.', subtext 'Current ratings and rankings, pulled directly from each platform.'). Tab switch: two Geist Mono 13px text toggles, GitHub and Competitive, sharing a layoutId hairline-gold underline (active-tab-indicator preserved). GitHub plate: a full-width row of four figures divided by hairline vertical rules, each figure Bodoni 400 3.5rem tabular (Contributions, Active days, Repositories, Lines written, sorted by value as today) with a Geist Mono 12px caption beneath and the lines-written hint kept as a title attribute; each figure links to its GitHub page. Below, the contribution heatmap as 12px square cells with 3px gaps using the gold ramp (level 0 obsidian-2, 1 aurum-400, 2 aurum-300, 3 aurum-200, 4 aurum-100), month labels in Geist Mono 11px above, weekday labels hidden on mobile as today; the current day's cell carries a 1px ivory-100 ring (a real state marker that anchors the ramp for visitors used to GitHub green). Below that a single 6px-tall language distribution bar with no track (the bar is the 100%) using ivory-100 at descending alphas per segment, with a Geist Mono 12px legend beneath; linguist colours are retired to honour the single accent. Competitive plate (CodingProfiles): the same figure-row grammar, one row per platform from the Codolio response (platform in Bodoni 500 22px, current rating, max rating, rank and problems solved as tabular Geist Mono 15px columns), hairline between rows. Loading: skeleton rows in the exact shape of the figure row in obsidian-2, no spinner. Error: one Geist 14px ivory-200 line, 'Live data is unavailable right now. Showing the last known figures.', with a Phosphor Warning (light, 16px) and the baked lines-written fallback rendered; no yellow pill. Mobile: figure row becomes 2x2 with hairlines; heatmap scrolls horizontally inside overflow-x auto.
sections.key_interaction: Tab toggle swaps plates with AnimatePresence mode wait; figures are links with a hairline-gold underline on hover; heatmap cells keep their native title tooltips.
sections.motion: Figures use the ledger roll-in keyed on the resolved value so the roll plays once when the fetch completes and never animates placeholder zeros (feedback: the numbers arrive from the network). Heatmap cells keep the CSS cellIn stagger as opacity 0 to 1 only, 250ms each, delay var(--d) capped at 900ms total, so the year fills like ink drying left to right (storytelling). Tab plates crossfade 350ms cubic-bezier(0.7,0,0.2,1) (state). Reduced motion: figures render final, cells appear at once.

sections.headline: Competitive record.
sections.subtext: Rankings across CodeChef, Codeforces and HackerRank, and 1,000+ problems solved.
sections.layout_family: Asymmetric display-numeral quartet (denomination layout, 7/5 then 5/7, ruled like a ledger sheet)
sections.composition: py-32 lg:py-40. h2 and subtext in columns 1-8 with drawn rule. Then four typographic blocks on the 12-column grid separated by hairline rules that organise the four cells (one horizontal between rows, one vertical between the cells of each row). Row one: columns 1-7 HackerRank, figure 'Top 0.07%' in Bodoni 400 7.5rem tabular; columns 8-12 CodeChef, figure 'Top 0.8%' at 5rem. Row two: columns 1-5 Codeforces, figure '1450' at 5rem with 'rating' in Geist Mono 12px beneath; columns 6-12 problems solved, figure '1,000+' at 7.5rem. Each block: figure, then title in Bodoni 500 22px ivory-100 (HackerRank 6-star gold; CodeChef 4-star; Codeforces Specialist; 1,000+ problems solved), then the description in Geist 15px ivory-200 max-w 36ch: 'Ranked in the top 0.07% of 26M+ developers on the platform.'; '4-star status (1864 rating). Top 0.8% among 2 million+ coders worldwide.'; 'Reached 1450 rating, outperforming 80% of global competitive programmers.'; 'Across LeetCode, TUF+, Codeforces, CodeChef and HackerRank. Depth across every major judge.' Each figure wrapper carries an aria-label with the full sentence. No icons, no cards, no glow blobs. Mobile: single column, figures at 3.5rem, hairline between blocks, order preserved.

signature_moments.name: Plate lift (masked headline and drawn rule)
signature_moments.where: The hero h1 and every h2 on the page
signature_moments.description: Each headline rises out of an overflow-hidden mask as if a printing plate were being lifted off the paper, while a 1px hairline-gold rule draws itself left to right directly beneath the baseline over the same span. Nothing blurs, nothing scales; the weight comes from the slow, symmetric ease. The rule belongs to the headline, so it organises real content rather than decorating the page.
signature_moments.why: Hierarchy: it tells the eye exactly where a chapter begins and gives every section one identical ritual, which is what makes nine components read as one document.
signature_moments.implementation_sketch: Reuse Reveal.tsx's IntersectionObserver-based in-view class and the existing .line-mask / .line-rise classes in globals.css, retuned: .in-view .line-rise animates translateY(110%) to 0 over 1100ms var(--ease-settle); a sibling .rule-draw span (position absolute, bottom -12px, left 0, width 100% of the headline's last line, height 1px, background hairline-gold, transform-origin left) transitions scaleX 0 to 1 over 900ms var(--ease-heavy) with a 150ms delay. Register --ease-settle: cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) and --ease-heavy: cubic-bezier(0.7,0,0.2,1) once in @theme inline. Framer is not needed for this moment. Every mask carries pb-2 so descenders are never clipped.
signature_moments.reduced_motion_fallback: Under prefers-reduced-motion the global kill-switch collapses durations; additionally .line-rise starts at translateY(0) and fades in over 200ms and .rule-draw renders at scaleX(1).
signature_moments.perf_notes: Transform and opacity only; will-change is set by the .in-view class and removed on animationend. content-visibility auto stays on sections that have no sticky descendants so off-screen headlines cost nothing.

signature_moments.name: Golden nebula handover with velocity heat
signature_moments.where: CosmicScene, hero chapter and contact chapter
signature_moments.description: The single gold nebula is at full intensity behind the hero portrait, dissolves to nothing before About finishes, leaves only a faint gold star chart during Skills, and returns low behind the contact letter. In the two live chapters the cloud heats with scroll velocity: colorB lerps toward colorA and the highlight brightens as the hand moves, cooling over about a second when it stops. The middle of the page is pure obsidian and type.
signature_moments.why: Storytelling: gold light exists only where the visitor meets Preetham directly, and it answers their own gesture there, so the WebGL reads as a signature twice rather than a screensaver nine times.
signature_moments.implementation_sketch: scene-store.ts: recolour every chapter to colorA #C9A961, colorB #7A6134, colorC #0C0A08; add intensity (hero 1, contact 1, all others 0) and constellationOpacity (skills 0.12, else 0); getSceneState lerps both with the existing blend; hero camera [0.9, 0.3, 6.5], contact camera [0, -0.6, 7]. CosmicScene.tsx (src/components/scene): add uIntensity and uConstellation uniforms written in the existing useFrame from the viewport-store progress it already reads; the nebula fragment multiplies alpha by uIntensity; the constellation material uses uConstellation with the existing category highlight lifting matching points to 0.6. Heat: in AuroraNebula's useFrame where vNorm already feeds uVelocity (around line 240), compute heat = vNorm * uIntensity and write uColorB = lerp(colorB, colorA, heat * 0.6) and uColorA scaled by 1 + heat * 0.25 before assigning uniforms. Halve the additive-blend opacities, retint GPUStars to ivory-200 at about 60% of current count, disable ShootingStar. When uIntensity and uConstellation are both 0 the frame loop early-returns after updating uniforms.
signature_moments.reduced_motion_fallback: CosmicScene's existing CSS fallback branch renders two static radial gradients in rgba(201,169,97,0.10), one at 78% 30% on the hero and one at 50% 85% inside the contact section; no canvas is mounted and there is no velocity response.
signature_moments.perf_notes: Zero additional draw calls; three float uniforms and two colour lerps per frame. The middle 80% of the page renders the canvas at near-zero GPU cost. useIdle deferral is kept so the hero is interactive before the three.js chunk loads. Check the gold on an OLED phone and a mid-range laptop after the recolour; if the cloud reads orange, darken colorB, never brighten it.

signature_moments.name: Ledger roll-in
signature_moments.where: About hanging figures, GitHub and Codolio figure rows, Achievements display numerals
signature_moments.description: Numerals do not count up from zero. Each digit column slides up once out of its own mask and lands, staggered 40ms per character from left to right, like a mechanical ledger settling. Tabular numerals keep the width fixed so nothing shifts.
signature_moments.why: Feedback: the figure arrives as a recorded value, not a slot-machine animation, which is the difference between an audited statement and a dashboard.
signature_moments.implementation_sketch: A LedgerNumber component splits the formatted string into character spans (digits, separators, prefix, suffix) inside an inline-flex wrapper with overflow hidden per character; each character is a motion.span with initial y '110%' and whileInView y 0, viewport once amount 0.6, transition duration 0.9, ease [0.16,1,0.3,1], delay index * 0.04. The wrapper carries font-variant-numeric tabular-nums lining-nums, an aria-label with the full formatted value (or the full sentence in Achievements), and every character span is aria-hidden so screen readers never hear digit soup. For live data the component keys on the resolved value so the roll plays once when the fetch completes and never on placeholders. It replaces AnimatedCounter and StatNumber in About.tsx, Achievements.tsx, GitHubStats.tsx and CodingProfiles.tsx.
signature_moments.reduced_motion_fallback: useReducedMotion returns true: characters render at y 0 and the wrapper fades in over 200ms.
signature_moments.perf_notes: At most about 40 animated spans on screen at once, transform only. The heatmap's 365 cells stay on the CSS cellIn path and are not routed through Framer.

signature_moments.name: Sticky year dossier
signature_moments.description: As the six grouped entries scroll past on the right, the start year in the sticky left column slides up out of view and the next year rises in, with company and role crossfading beneath it, so the column behaves like the year tabs of an annual report.
signature_moments.why: State: it tells the reader which chapter of the record they are in without a rail, nodes or pings.
signature_moments.implementation_sketch: Each entry wraps in a ref observed with useInView({ amount: 0.5 }) that sets activeIndex in the section's state. The sticky column (position sticky, top 128px, hidden below lg) renders AnimatePresence mode popLayout around a motion.span keyed by the active year with initial y '100%', animate y 0, exit y '-100%', transition 0.7s in / 0.5s out with ease [0.7,0,0.2,1] inside an overflow-hidden mask; company and role sit in a second AnimatePresence with opacity-only 400ms. No useScroll in this section. Remove the cv-auto class from this section's ScrollReveal wrapper in page.tsx and size its dynamic() loading skeleton to the section's real height so the sticky column is never clipped.
signature_moments.reduced_motion_fallback: AnimatePresence initial false with transition duration 0: the column swaps instantly.
signature_moments.perf_notes: Six IntersectionObservers, one sticky element, transforms only. SmoothScroll.tsx runs Lenis on native scroll with no transform wrapper, so position sticky works; verify no overflow hidden ancestor is introduced.

signature_moments.name: Dossier open (grid accordion with unveiled screenshot)
signature_moments.description: Opening a project row expands its panel with a heavy grid-row animation while the real product screenshot wipes in from the left behind a hairline frame; the previous row closes in the same motion so exactly one dossier is open at a time.
signature_moments.why: State and storytelling: the visitor chooses what to inspect, and the product is unveiled rather than dumped on the page.
signature_moments.implementation_sketch: Each row header is a button with aria-expanded and aria-controls; the panel is a sibling div with display grid, grid-template-rows 0fr toggled to 1fr via a data-open attribute, transition grid-template-rows 650ms var(--ease-heavy), and an inner div with min-height 0 and overflow hidden. Inside, the screenshot img (next/image unoptimized static WebP, width 1600 height 1000, loading lazy, decoding async) sits in a motion.div animating clipPath 'inset(0 100% 0 0)' to 'inset(0 0 0 0)' over 0.9s after a 0.2s delay; text children fade in over 0.35s after 0.2s using AnimatePresence. The Phosphor Plus is a motion.span rotating 0 to 45 degrees in 0.4s. No Framer layout or height auto anywhere.
signature_moments.reduced_motion_fallback: grid-template-rows transition 0ms, clip-path transition 0ms, panel content fades 200ms, the Plus swaps to X without rotation.
signature_moments.perf_notes: grid-template-rows interpolation needs no height measurement and causes no per-frame layout on siblings; only one panel animates at a time. clip-path inset is composited in Chromium and Safari 16+. The three screenshots are below the fold and lazy-loaded.

signature_moments.name: Match cut (loader line to headline rule)
signature_moments.description: The loader is an obsidian panel with the name in Bodoni and a 240px aurum line that fills with real warm-up progress. On completion the line stretches to the full viewport width, the panel wipes upward to reveal the composed hero, and the same line contracts to become the hairline-gold rule under the headline's second line as the two lines rise onto it.
signature_moments.why: Hierarchy and storytelling: one continuous element hands the visitor's eye from the load to the headline, and the loader's only ornament becomes the page's first piece of real structure.
signature_moments.implementation_sketch: PageLoader.tsx keeps the warmedSceneCount / TOTAL_WARMED_SCENES progress, MIN_SHOWN lowered to 1400ms (stated in the PR) and MAX_WAIT 5000ms. Layout: fixed inset-0 bg obsidian-0; centre 'Preetham Nimmagadda' in Bodoni 400 28px (36px at lg) ivory-100 revealed by clip-path inset(0 100% 0 0) to inset(0) over 900ms var(--ease-heavy) starting 150ms after mount; 24px beneath, a 240px hairline over which an aurum-300 motion.div grows scaleX from progress. Exit: the gold line's scaleX animates to viewport width (origin centre, 500ms var(--ease-settle)), the name fades 300ms, the panel wipes clip-path inset(0 0 100% 0) over 900ms var(--ease-heavy); loader-done and window.__loaderDone fire at the start of the wipe. The hero mounts its own .rule-draw under the h1 at scaleX 1 and full width at t=0 of its clock and animates it to the headline width over 700ms while the panel clears; the loader's line fades at the same moment so the swap is invisible. aria-busy on body while shown, role status with visually hidden 'Loading'.
signature_moments.reduced_motion_fallback: Name and line appear at once, MIN_SHOWN drops to 600ms, the panel fades out over 200ms, the hero rule renders in place with no contraction.
signature_moments.perf_notes: Three transform or opacity animations and one clip-path on a single full-screen layer; no starfield, no conic glow, no radial blur. will-change removed after exit.

signature_moments.name: Portrait grade lift
signature_moments.description: The headshot rests as a warm monochrome photogravure and returns to full colour over 900ms when hovered or focused, then drains back when the pointer leaves.
signature_moments.why: Feedback: the portrait acknowledges the visitor, and the monochrome rest state keeps the hero's only colour reserved for the gold.
signature_moments.implementation_sketch: PortraitPlate.tsx renders two absolutely stacked picture elements of the same source inside the 4:5 plate: .plate-mono with a static filter grayscale(1) sepia(0.28) contrast(1.06) brightness(0.92), and .plate-color above it with opacity 0 and transition opacity 900ms var(--ease-heavy). .plate:hover .plate-color, .plate:focus-within .plate-color { opacity: 1 }. The colour layer is aria-hidden and the mono layer carries the alt text. Two absolutely positioned hairline frames (inset 0 and inset 12px) complete the double bezel; the figure has tabIndex 0 so keyboard users can trigger it.
signature_moments.reduced_motion_fallback: Transition duration 0 so the grade swaps instantly on hover; a single CSS custom property (--portrait-rest-color: 1) lets the owner leave the image in colour permanently.
signature_moments.perf_notes: Opacity only, compositor-bound; the filter is static and painted once. The mono layer keeps loading eager, fetchPriority high, width and height so it remains the LCP element; the colour layer shares the decoded source.

loader: A full-screen obsidian-0 panel with two elements centred. 'Preetham Nimmagadda' in Bodoni Moda 400 at 28px (36px at lg) ivory-100, revealed by a clip-path inset(0 100% 0 0) to inset(0) wipe over 900ms cubic-bezier(0.7,0,0.2,1) starting 150ms after mount, like foil pressed across the page. 24px beneath it a 240px by 1px hairline over which an aurum-300 line grows scaleX from the left, driven by the existing warmedSceneCount / TOTAL_WARMED_SCENES progress. copy_voice: Rules: sentence case for every headline, label and button except the three uppercase eyebrows. Short declaratives, one idea per sentence, prefer a period to a conjunction. Figures as numerals exactly as the source states them, with their plus signs (1,800+, 1,500+, 0.07%, 95%, 1000+ inside Prof. Mukherjee's quote stays 1000+ because it is verbatim). Periods and ranges use 'to' ('Mar 2026 to present'); the only permitted dash is the hyphen inside compound words (self-healing, full-time, real-time, 4-star, 6-star). No em or en dash anywhere, including alt text, aria labels, tooltips, title attributes and error messages; restructure with commas, colons, parentheses or periods. First person allowed in About and Contact, absent elsewhere; third person only inside verbatim quotes. Concrete verbs (build, ship, remediate, lead, rank); banned: elevate, seamless, seamlessly, unleash, next-gen, revolutionize, delve, tapestry, empower, passionate, journey as a career noun, cutting-edge. The one exception is Sneha Patil's 'revolutionary', which is her word inside a verbatim quote and is not edited. Real titles are used as written (Campus Ambassador, Student Senator, Hostel Prefect, Machine Learning Intern). No superlative the record does not already state. One label per intent across the page: 'Get in touch' for contact (hero, nav, footer), 'View selected work' for the portfolio (hero only), 'Send message' for the form submit. The middle dot appears at most once per line and only in metadata (company and period in Experience). Third-party quotes are never trimmed or reworded; only dash characters are replaced. A build step greps src for U+2014, U+2013 and the banned word list and fails the build on a hit. Five rewrites from the real content: 1) Hero, was 'REDEFINING AI SECURITY' with 'Architecting Autonomous Defense Systems', a role typewriter, three stats and two badges; now 'AI that acts, not just answers.' with the 17-word subtext 'Autonomous agents, multimodal RAG and self-healing data security, built at Matters.AI, Introspect Labs and IIT (ISM) Dhanbad.' 2) Experience, Matters.AI, was 'Building the AI copilot that finds data exposures in real time and remediates them automatically — turning data security from passive monitoring into a self-healing defense layer.'; now 'Building the AI copilot that finds data exposures in real time and remediates them automatically, turning data security from passive monitoring into a self-healing defense layer.' 3) Projects, College Central, was 'The digital backbone of IIT (ISM) Dhanbad — one platform for academic records, campus navigation, and event coordination, used daily by the student body.'; now 'One platform for academic records, campus navigation and event coordination at IIT (ISM) Dhanbad, used daily by the student body.' 4) Testimonials, Meera Iyer, was 'Sub-second latency across languages — that's production-level engineering.'; now 'Sub-second latency across languages, that's production-level engineering.' (Ankit Sharma's 'doesn't just build — he ships' becomes 'doesn't just build, he ships'; Rohan Gupta's 'infrastructure — EC2, GPU instances, networking — like' becomes 'infrastructure (EC2, GPU instances, networking) like'.) 5) Achievements header, was 'My Achievements' with 'Numbers earned through thousands of hours at the keyboard.'; now 'Competitive record.' with 'Rankings across CodeChef, Codeforces and HackerRank, and 1,000+ problems solved.' Also: Contact was 'Get in Touch' plus 'Let's build something that matters'; now 'Get in touch.' with 'Internships, full-time roles and collaborations in AI and autonomous systems. Replies within 24 hours.' Projects subtext was 'Five builds that shipped, scaled, and solved real problems.' for six projects; now 'Six builds, three of them live.' The Competitive tab h2 is 'Ratings from five platforms, live.' (LeetCode, Codeforces, CodeChef, HackerRank, TakeUForward, as returned by Codolio).
eyebrow_budget: Exactly three eyebrows on the page, each separated by at least two eyebrow-free sections: (1) home: 'AI ENGINEER, IIT (ISM) DHANBAD'; (2) github-stats: 'LIVE FROM GITHUB AND CODOLIO' (a real data-provenance statement); (3) contact: 'AVAILABLE FOR INTERNSHIPS AND FULL-TIME ROLES', preceded by the single 6px gold live-availability indicator. Sections about, experience, skills-sphere, projects, achievements and testimonials carry no eyebrow, no section number and no kicker; the SectionKicker component and its numbering are deleted. The Experience group labels 'Industry' and 'Campus' are sentence-case Geist 13px inside the list, not uppercase tracked labels above a headline, so they do not count. Mechanical check: grep for 'uppercase tracking' in src/components must return exactly these three strings, and none in Navbar.tsx or Footer.tsx.
risks: Bodoni Moda hairlines below about 22px break up on Windows ClearType and low-DPI displays; the direction forbids the display face under 22px and routes all small text to Geist. The implementer must confirm next/font applies the opsz axis (Bodoni_Moda with axes ['opsz'] and font-optical-sizing auto) and must not reach for Bodoni in tags, labels or nav.

Recolouring every CosmicScene chapter from violet and cyan to one gold family can turn orange or muddy; colorB must stay the umber #7A6134, additive-blend opacities are halved, stars go ivory-200 at reduced count, and the result must be checked on an OLED phone and a mid-range laptop. If the cloud still reads orange, darken colorB rather than brightening colorA.

Real screenshots exist for none of the projects yet; the three live products (collegecentral.live, festflow.co.in, the CareerOps host) must be captured at 1600x1000 and committed to /public/projects before the dossier ships. The three Complete projects get no image and no GitHub social card; div mock-ups are forbidden under any circumstance.

The single-accent lock moves the GitHub language bar off linguist colours onto ivory alphas and the heatmap onto the gold ramp; visitors used to GitHub green may read it slower. position: sticky in the Experience column requires removing the cv-auto content-visibility class from that section's ScrollReveal wrapper in page.tsx and sizing its dynamic() skeleton to match; sticky also fails inside any overflow hidden or transformed ancestor, so SmoothScroll's DOM must stay a plain native-scroll wrapper. About no longer uses sticky, which removes one such risk.

grid-template-rows 0fr to 1fr interpolation is supported in all evergreen browsers since 2023 and in Safari 16+; older Safari sees an instant open, which is the reduced-motion behaviour anyway. clip-path inset wipes should be profiled on a mid-range Android device.

ivory-300 (#857D70) is 4.86:1 on obsidian-0 and may only be used at 12px or larger for metadata, never for body text. Form errors use aurum-200 with a Warning icon and aria-invalid, which is on-brand but breaks the red-means-error convention; if usability testing shows confusion the owner may approve exactly one desaturated brick (for example #C0655B) documented as a semantic error state and used nowhere else.
